productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
_**Yoto Says:** These are tunes to get you moving and grooving in the sunshine. Full of fun and movement, they are the ultimate summertime tunes._
**_Digital Card:_** Get instant access in the Yoto App when you buy this digital card. Play it anywhere using the app or link it to a [Make Your Own Card](https://yotoplay.com/pages/makeyourown "Make Your Own Cards") for your kids to enjoy whenever they like. Looking for the physical Yoto Card? Find it [here](https://yotoplay.com/products/summer-jams "Summer Jams"). _**Description﻿:**_ Summer Jams is a collection of tunes to soundtrack your ultimate sunny days. Take a trip to the skatepark, jump on a surfboard or go camping with your friends. These imaginative and fun-filled tracks are bound to get the whole family moving and grooving.
Packed full of imaginative lyrics and funky beats you’ll find it impossible to sit still. There are songs that encourage participation and play and they are guaranteed to make you smile, any time of the year.

1. Summer Jam

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
